title: Children and Dogs Posing Outdoors, 1930s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor gathering of ten children and two dogs posing in a grassy yard, likely during summer in the interwar era circa 1930. The standing girls wear period cotton dresses with wide collars and oversized hair bows, showcasing popular bobbed hairstyles. In the front row, boys kneel in overalls and collared shirts, with one playfully aiming a toy revolver directly toward the lens while another cradles a small terrier. A swing set frame is partially visible in the right background.
